description.para: The following constants map to the XPAR parameters created in the xparameters.h file.
They are defined here so that all the needed parameters can be easily changed in one place.
The following are declared globally so they are zeroed and so they are easily accessible from a debugger.

briefdescription.para: Driver instance for the GPIO device used as output.
Driver instance for the GPIO device used as input.

detaileddescription.para: The following constant is used to wait after an LED is turned on to make sure that it is visible to the human eye. This constant might need to be tuned for faster or slower processor speeds.
The following constant is used to determine which channel of the GPIO is used if there are two channels supported in the GPIO.

briefdescription.para: Number of times the LED blinks.
Runs a minimal test on the GPIO device configured as output.

briefdescription.para: Tests the GPIO device configured as input.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer where the data read from the GPIO input is returned.

XST_FAILURE if the test is not successful.

briefdescription.para: Demonstrates usage of AXI GPIO hardware and driver.

detaileddescription.para: This file contains an example for using AXI GPIO hardware and driver. This example assumes that there is a UART Device or STDIO Device in the hardware system.
